decisions.reason: The consumer-oriented superfood drink is peripheral to the core waste-to-resource business and likely falls short of performance aspirations, leading management to reallocate resources.
As a modular extension of the established waste-to-energy line, it supports core offerings and is unlikely to be dropped despite limited standalone visibility.
With a quantified launch and dedicated pages, this core waste-oil-to-energy plant shows strong evidence of meeting aspirations and will be kept.
Close to the firm's established plastic-waste conversion activities and promoted on its own page, it likely meets aspirations and remains in the portfolio.
